name: Hyakuachi Rensei ☆ Suikoden
source:
You chose a book at the library you always visit.
The book suddenly begins shining, and before you know it,
You're suddenly thrown into Mount Liang, a huge mountain fort in the middle of a lake.

In order to save the citizens of a land that suffered defeat, 108 handsome heroes gathered at Mount Liang. You end up living with them, until the day you can return to your own world.

From noble knight commanders with a refreshing smile that captivate ladies, to arrogant Navy commanders that can make any lady fall for him, to tacticians cold on the outside but easily embarrassed on the inside who take females as research targets, 
you spend everyday in this unfamiliar environment getting played around by these men and some feelings will be born...
translation:
你在常去的圖書館選了一本書。

書本突然發光，轉眼間，你被扔進湖中央的巨大山寨——梁山。

為了拯救戰敗之地的居民，一百零八名俊俏好漢聚集在梁山。在能回到自己的世界前，你要和他們一起生活。

從笑容清爽、能俘獲女性的高貴騎士指揮官，到能讓任何女性墜入愛河的傲慢海軍指揮官，再到外冷內熱、容易害羞、把女性當作研究對象的軍師，你將在陌生環境中每天被這些男人捉弄，並逐漸產生某些感情……
